mapper.select: SELECT address AS tagname, alarm_msg AS alarmdesc, occur_time_str AS time, clear_time_str AS lead_alarmtime FROM vw_alarm_history WHERE 1=1 AND ( occur_time BETWEEN #{sdateTime} AND #{edateTime} OR clear_time BETWEEN #{sdateTime} AND #{edateTime} ) ORDER BY occur_time DESC
SELECT alarm_msg AS alarmdesc, occur_time_str AS time FROM vw_alarm_history WHERE alarm_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY occur_time DESC
